title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-16 11:46:44 最新章节：第 86 章青璇离去陆成相救凌雪瑶
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
“能与本宗主双修，也算是你的造化了！”
迷迷糊糊间，一个冰冷的女子声在耳旁响起。
陆成很累很虚，感觉自己的腰和双腿都在剧烈打颤。
他缓缓睁开双眸，下意识一抓，一股光滑柔软且弹性惊人的触感传来。
“你没死？”
这个时候，那冰冷的女子声音再度响起。
陆成看向旁边，他的手正抓在一女子笔直q弹的雪腿上，视线上移，他瞬间整个人宛如被勾去魂魄般，目瞪口呆。
她怎么没穿衣服？
她那完美的身姿，前凸后翘，肤白如雪，就这么毫无保留，淋漓尽致地展现在了陆成的眼前。
不……这不是重点！
重点是她那倾国倾城的脸，让他彻底无法挪开视线，她的神情散发着上位者的气息，冰冷，高贵，宛如天上仙女般不可亵渎。
“有意思。”女子看着陆成，被对方直勾勾盯着，她脸上没有丝毫娇羞，也没有丝毫慌乱，反而嘴角露出饶有兴趣之色。
“你一个杂役弟子，与本宗主双修，竟然还能捡回来一条命！”女子看着陆成，“看来你倒是一个不错的炉鼎，好好修炼，五天后，我会再来与你双修。”
女子说着，便缓缓起身走下床。
在陆成猛咽口水时，她手中凭空出现一件长衫，将她那妖娆的身姿完美掩盖了起来。
陆成都有些看呆了。
“看够了没有？”女子冰冷的声音将陆成拉回现实。
女子整理了下凌乱的黑发，淡淡地说道：“既然你是本宗主的炉鼎，那就要好好修炼，尽快提升修为，这是十枚夺灵丹，希望五天内你能突破炼气一层，否则下次双修你必死无疑！”
说完女子便向门外走去，却又停了下来，冰冷的声音从她身后传来：“我与你双修的事情，本宗主不希望第二个人知晓，否则……后果你应该清楚！”
看着女子走出门并关上门后离开，陆成望着窗外飞上天的绝美背影，回神揉着腰扶着腿从床上坐了起来。

他面前的床单，一片浸湿，可想而知方才到底是有多疯狂。
陆成望着旁边的十颗硬币大小的夺灵丹，眼神古怪。
“我不是在做梦吧！”
“这是嫖资？”
陆成喃喃低语。
就在这时，他只感觉脑袋传来剧烈的眩晕，大量的记忆涌入他的脑海。
强烈的冲击让他双手抱头，腰和双腿酸痛打颤，差点昏厥在床上。
他望着面前蛛网般满是裂痕的墙壁，地面上杂乱无章的工具，整个人感觉脑瓜子嗡嗡的。
“我这是穿越了？”陆成呆呆地望着眼前陌生的环境。
脑海的记忆不断涌来，这里是青玄宗杂役峰的废丹房。
原主三年前被带往青玄宗检测灵根，结果检测出五行杂灵根，灵根越少，感悟天地灵气修炼的速度就越快，而五行灵根，则是最废的灵根。
青玄宗自然不会为他投入资源培养，而原主没有选择回世俗，甘愿来废丹房当一个杂役弟子，因为杂役弟子一个月也可以领到两枚夺灵丹，也有修炼的机会。
就在三个时辰前，突然有一个女子从天而降，而那女子自称是青玄宗的宗主林倾月，强行与他双修。
林倾月告诉原主，说需要与他双修，双修之后，原主可能会死，但是他会在享受和幸福中死去。
原主在废丹院处理废丹，早已被丹毒感染，若不能修炼的话早晚会死。
于是，原主同意了！
然后……这个世界十五岁的陆成，就被林倾月给睡了。
原主也在双修幸福和快乐中死了，这才给了他鸠占鹊巢的机会。
陆成心中悸动，原主与林倾月双修的滋味仿佛亲身经历一般，即便是前世在某些会所之中，他都没有体验过这么舒服的感觉。
两世记忆加起来，这种级别的美女，他从未见到过，哪怕影视剧中那种美若天仙的女巨星，在林倾月的面前都会黯然失色。
content_en:
"It's your blessing to be able to practice dual cultivation with this sect leader!"
Drowsily, a cold female voice sounded in his ears.
Lu Cheng was very tired and weak, and felt that his waist and legs were shaking violently.
He slowly opened his eyes and subconsciously grabbed it, feeling a smooth, soft and surprisingly elastic touch.
"You're not dead?"
At this time, the cold female voice sounded again.
Lu Cheng looked to the side. His hand was grasping a woman's straight legs. His eyes moved upward. He felt as if his soul had been taken away from him, and he was stunned.
Why isn't she wearing any clothes?
Her perfect figure, with curved front and back, and skin as white as snow, was displayed in front of Lu Cheng's eyes without any reservation.
No...that's not the point!
The key point was her stunning face, which made him completely unable to take his eyes away. Her expression exuded the aura of a superior, cold, noble, and indestructible like a fairy in the sky.
"Interesting." The woman looked at Lu Cheng, who was staring straight at him. There was no shyness or panic on her face, but a look of interest on her lips.
"You, a handyman disciple, can still save a life by practicing dual cultivation with this sect leader!" The woman looked at Lu Cheng, "It seems that you are a good furnace. Practice well. In five days, I will come back to dual cultivation with you."
As the woman spoke, she slowly got up and walked out of bed.
When Lu Cheng swallowed hard, a gown appeared out of thin air in her hand, perfectly covering up her enchanting figure.
Lu Chengdu was dumbfounded.
"Have you seen enough?" The woman's cold voice brought Lu Cheng back to reality.
The woman straightened her messy black hair and said calmly: "Since you are the cauldron of this sect master, you must practice hard and improve your cultivation as soon as possible. Here are ten spirit-seizing pills. I hope you can break through the first level of Qi refining within five days, otherwise you will definitely die next time you practice dual cultivation!"
After saying that, the woman walked out of the door, but stopped again. A cold voice came from behind her: "This sect leader does not want the second person to know about your dual cultivation, otherwise... you should know the consequences!"
After watching the woman walk out the door, close the door and leave, Lu Cheng looked at the beautiful back flying into the sky outside the window, regained consciousness, rubbed his waist, held his legs and sat up from the bed.
The sheets in front of him were soaked, and one could only imagine how crazy he was just now.
Lu Cheng looked at the ten coin-sized elixirs next to him with strange eyes.
"I'm not dreaming!"
"Is this prostitution?"
Lu Cheng murmured.
At this moment, he felt a severe dizziness in his head, and a large number of memories poured into his mind.
The strong impact made him hold his head in his hands, his waist and legs were sore and trembling, and he almost fainted on the bed.
He looked at the spiderweb-like wall in front of him, which was full of cracks, and the messy tools on the ground, and his whole body felt like his head was buzzing.
"Have I traveled through time?" Lu Cheng stared blankly at the unfamiliar environment in front of him.
Memories kept coming back to my mind. This was the abandoned alchemy room of Qingxuan Sect's Miscellaneous Peak.
The original owner was taken to Qingxuan Sect to test the spiritual roots three years ago. The result was that the five elements of mixed spiritual roots were detected. The fewer the spiritual roots, the faster the spiritual energy of heaven and earth can be cultivated. The five elements of spiritual roots are the most useless spiritual roots.
Naturally, Qingxuan Sect would not invest resources in cultivating him, but the original owner did not choose to return to the secular world, and was willing to come to the Waste Pill Room to be a handyman disciple, because the handyman disciples could also receive two spirit-seizing pills a month, and also had the opportunity to practice.
Just three hours ago, a woman suddenly fell from the sky, and the woman claimed to be Lin Qingyue, the leader of Qingxuan Sect, and forced herself to practice dual cultivation with him.
Lin Qingyue told the original owner that she needed to practice double cultivation with him. After dual cultivation, the original owner might die, but he would die in enjoyment and happiness.
The original owner was dealing with waste pills in the waste pill courtyard. He had already been infected by erysipelas. If he could not practice, he would die sooner or later.
So, the original owner agreed!
Then...the fifteen-year-old in this worldLu Cheng was slept with by Lin Qingyue.
The original owner also died in the happiness and joy of dual cultivation, which gave him the opportunity to occupy the magpie's nest.
Lu Cheng's heart palpitated, as if the original owner and Lin Qingyue were experiencing dual cultivation, he had never experienced such a comfortable feeling even in some clubs in his previous life.
In the combined memories of two lifetimes, he had never seen a beauty of this level. Even the kind of female superstars in movies and TV series who were as beautiful as gods would be eclipsed in front of Lin Qingyue.
